decisions.decision: Plan-checker found 2 BLOCKERS -- fixed via direct Edit, NOT via planner re-spawn
decisions.rationale: Both blockers were mechanical metadata fixes (frontmatter depends_on + ctest name in VALIDATION.md). The checker's `fix:` directives were prescriptive 1-2 line changes. Spawning a full gsd-planner Agent (~$0.30) for what Edit produces in 30 seconds was procedural overkill. Re-check pass returned VERIFICATION PASSED.

Originally planner had 14.3-02 + 14.3-03 in parallel (wave 2). Plan-checker correctly flagged that 14.3-03's must_haves explicitly self-document a hard dependency on 14.3-02's deliverables. Promoted 14.3-03 to wave 3 with depends_on: ['14.3-01', '14.3-02'].
